reading: The United States is pressing Iran to pledge an end to any hostile actions against vessels in the vital Strait of Hormuz.
This critical demand follows recent incidents that have raised global concerns about maritime safety.
High-level US officials are preparing for important diplomatic meetings this weekend.
Vice-President JD Vance is among US officials expected to take part in negotiations resuming on Saturday in Oman.
These negotiations aim to secure a formal commitment from Iran.
The US wants Iran to pledge to stop shooting at ships in the important shipping lane.
International observers are closely monitoring these diplomatic efforts to ensure regional stability.
The discussions will focus on establishing clear protocols for preventing future conflicts.
It is hoped that a lasting agreement can be reached to protect international shipping.
The Strait of Hormuz is a strategically important waterway for global oil shipments.

vocabulary.definition: Starting again after a pause or interruption; continuing from where something left off.
very important, especially at a difficult or dangerous time
a firm promise to do something
watching a situation carefully over time to notice changes
a decision or arrangement accepted by the people involved
people who watch events carefully and report what they notice

entries.ja: 一時停止や中断の後、再び始めること。中断したところから続けること。
entries.ko: 일시 정지하거나 중단된 후에 다시 시작하는 것; 멈췄던 지점부터 계속하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在暂停或中断之后再次开始；从中断的地方继续。
entries.es: Empezar de nuevo después de una pausa o interrupción; continuar desde donde se dejó.
entries.pt-BR: Começar novamente após uma pausa ou interrupção; continuar de onde parou.

entries.ja: 特に困難な時や危険な時に、非常に重要なこと。
entries.ko: 특히 어렵거나 위험한 시기에 매우 중요한.
entries.zh-Hans: 非常重要的，尤其是在困难或危险时期。
entries.es: Muy importante, especialmente en un momento difícil o peligroso.
entries.pt-BR: Muito importante, especialmente em um momento difícil ou perigoso.

entries.ja: 何かを行うという固い約束。
entries.es: Una promesa firme de hacer algo.
entries.pt-BR: Uma promessa firme de fazer algo.

entries.ja: 状況の変化に気づくために、時間をかけて注意深く状況を観察すること。
entries.ko: 시간이 지남에 따라 변화를 알아차리기 위해 어떤 상황을 주의 깊게 지켜보는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 长时间仔细观察某种情况以注意变化。
entries.es: Observar una situación con atención a lo largo del tiempo para notar cambios.
entries.pt-BR: Observar uma situação cuidadosamente ao longo do tempo para notar mudanças.

entries.ja: 何かが起こるのを止めること。
entries.ko: 어떤 일이 일어나지 않도록 막는 것.

entries.ja: 関係する人々によって受け入れられた決定や取り決め。
entries.zh-Hans: 相关各方都接受的决定或安排。
entries.es: Una decisión o acuerdo aceptado por las personas involucradas.
entries.pt-BR: Uma decisão ou um arranjo aceito pelas pessoas envolvidas.

entries.ja: 出来事を注意深く観察し、気づいたことを報告する人々。
entries.ko: 사건을 주의 깊게 지켜보고 자신이 알아차린 것을 보고하는 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 仔细观察事件并报告他们所注意到的人。
entries.es: Personas que observan los acontecimientos con atención y reportan lo que notan.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que observam eventos cuidadosamente e relatam o que percebem.
